candidate_grammar.boundary: Every positive finite RECORD-001 data item, schema, provenance chain, dataset and registered successor boundary.

excluded_inputs: no axiom, imported data model, database convention or target outcome selects the result
displayed 0 denotes structural absence only and is not an SFT number object
no negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof scalar
no silent overwrite, hidden missing value, erased alias or unrecorded provenance step
no sampled row family or unregistered infinite dataset
no failed route retires an obligation or changes protected authority
statement: A data item is an exact source-bound field/value record whose canonical identity includes its provenance-bearing source, declared field and complete exact value.
title: Data item and record identity
